questions.question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Salman is an immediate neighbour of both Kiran and Shwetha. Bala is sitting second right to Salman. Shwetha is sitting third to the left of Bala. Akshay is an immediate neighbour of both Bala and Nishitha. Who is the immediate neighbour of Nishitha and Salman?
questions.solution:
*-From the given information:/

Step 1: Salman is an immediate neighbour of both Kiran and Shwetha. Bala is sitting second right to Salman.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28b884d8b7d35c6734155d9f29a5873cfeae278e298fbdfe47d435835307270a.png] 

We place Salman in between Shwetha and Kiran and then place Bala second to the right of Salman.

Step 2: Shwetha is sitting third to the left of Bala. Akshay is an immediate neighbour of both Bala and Nishitha.

-* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82761cb439850c8543d63b362e31a16270b4e4beb90e2a10cf259835c8f2e191.png] 

We place Akshay next to Bala and then place Nishitha at the last spot left.

From the arrangement, we can see that **Shwetha is the immediate neighbour of Nishitha and Salman.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 3).**

questions.question:

hence the correct answer is** "Option 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9df8548f4b6a695eb8b459d32e80116260d248f038e84ce67f676d992a718844.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb9173f4291391c0b961bd7d0a33d0e082f014c7a3a306cb7daca0ea42414f47.png] 

2) Both L and M are immediate neighbours of J.

3) O is not an immediate neighbour of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6949fba137ca9d60ed05d3b8283d98c5d404d4050a4495476272e1d600aed740.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c7bd6e76b4075629e5883d7bc45e4b4773c46911088c43189a5a7932b270a4a.png] 

4) Only one person sits between M and P.

After positioning P only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. K. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/476146eca55896b74e05e7ba4609d7ca1a4fc78ecd9dc172469bd4d397bc1b52.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87ba6748ed018606a088cee37963b5e24927a9b88224a028c153d1da0d43d4a9.png] 

Thus, L is sitting to the immediate right of K.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
